newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Acacia takes 100 pct of Lake Cowan jv.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Acacia takes 100 pct of Lake Cowan jv.

text.p: Gold miner Acacia Resources Ltd said on Wednesday it had purchased the remaining 50 percent of the Lake Cowan joint venture and nearby tenements from its partner in the venture Consolidated Gold NL.
The A$2.1 million purchase would be settled following the usual government approvals, Acacia said in a statement.
The Lake Cowan tenements are located south of WMC Ltd's St Ives gold mine in Western Australia and have identified resources of 140,000 ounces of gold, Acacia said.
The company said exploration at Lake Cowan would be expanded during calendar 1997. -- Melbourne bureau 61-3 9286-1435
